text:
Anna Patel: Heads up — VelaGrid pilot returned signed SOW w/ request for 60% off list for first 90 days + net60 billing. Need deal desk sign-off. Details below.

Mike Chen: Who owns the account and what are the projected usage/ARR numbers?

Anna Patel: Owner: Anna + Mike (sales). Pilot 6mo, est 120M tokens/mo (embeddings + gen). Likely convert to Dedicated in Q4 if latency/cost OK.

Jordan Lee: Finance note: we typically don't approve >45% off for pilots without exec sign-off. Net60 on a new midmarket customer increases credit risk. Can this be structured as a one-time onboarding credit instead of a % discount?

Anna Patel: Customer is pushing hard on net60. We can propose onboarding credit (invoiced as credit) of $10k + 40% off first 2 months instead of 60% ongoing. Customer prefers simple percent. Any flexibility on finance side? Also flag on revenue recognition?

Laura Gomez: If we record as a one-time credit we can avoid changing list pricing and keep revenue recognition straightforward (gross invoice then apply contra-revenue credit). Ops can process an onboarding credit against invoice. For net60, AR will need a signed SOW and sales guarantee/PO. For discounts >45% we need deal desk escalation per policy.

Jordan Lee: Confirming policy: finance can approve up to 45% for pilot deals where projected ARR < $200k and security review is green. 60% requires CFO or VP-Finance approval. I'm escalating. @dealbot please open an approval request.

Anna Patel: Quick propose for discussion:
```
Item: Pilot access (120M tokens/mo) - list $12,000/mo
Requested discount: 60%
Finance counter: 45% discount + $8,000 one-time onboarding credit
Billing term: Net30 preferred; customer wants Net60
```

dealbot: Approval created: APP-4821 -> assigned to Jordan Lee + CFO review. Summary: VelaGrid pilot (60% off + net60 request). Link: https://internal/approvals/APP-4821 :white_check_mark:

Mike Chen: :eyes: Thanks — sales can accept 45% + $8k credit if that closes faster. We'll push customer to Net30 and provide PO to AR.

Anna Patel: Great — I'll update SOW to reflect finance counter and note pending approval. Will hold execution until APP-4821 resolved. Thanks everyone.
